The '''Gralleenya Gala''' was a [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long celebration to honor [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. It was a series of parades and parties, and all revelers were ordered to have fun or else.
